observation.happening: Active Google Meet recording with live transcript organized into semantic sections (Live notes, Decisions, Overview, Tasks, Questions). Japanese language conversation showing meeting participants contributing at different timestamps.
observation.most_important: Multi-section categorization of conversation with timestamped speaker attribution and semantic grouping (decisions vs. questions vs. tasks)
observation.next_action: Review categorized notes, access meeting controls (captions, Ask Astra, mute), or expand conversation view
anomalies: Left edge has inconsistent alignment due to natural timestamp/speaker name variation
Section header 'ライブメモ' in top left appears as functional label rather than visual hierarchy marker

FBBE.why: Solid functional design with clear semantic categorization and good contrast. However, lacks refinement in spacing consistency and visual polish expected of category leaders. Transcript section feels utilitarian rather than crafted.

observation.happening: Google Meet header bar showing recording status. Red live indicator and 00:00 timer at left; right side shows action buttons (captions, Ask Astra, eye, pause, stop recording).
observation.most_important: Recording state is immediately and unambiguously clear via color (red dot) and text ('録音中' = Recording)
observation.next_action: Control meeting state via buttons: toggle captions, access Astra, mute, or stop recording

FD1D.why: Header bar execution is extremely polished with excellent minimalism and state clarity. However, as a header component alone, assessment is limited — verdict reflects execution quality rather than full product evaluation. No defects visible; design is clean and intentional.
